# Particle FX catalog (summary)

Generated by `tools/particle-fx/catalog_doc.py` from `data/particle-fx-catalog.json` — the source of truth for `?particleFx` (see docs/url-flags.md and docs/HANDOFF-particle-fx-2026-10-09.md). Every one of the 2051 retail ParticleEmitters has an entry with its own note and params; this page groups them by visual family and samples the notes. Param keys: gain/core (HDR + hot core), tint0→tint1 (colour over life), fadeIn/fadeOut, erode, flicker/twinkle/pulse, spin, wobble, soft (m), nearFade (m), lit.

## star — 501 emitters

_4-point star flare / sparkle_

Behaviours: swarm 190, burst 139, standing 85, trail 27, fountain 24, implode 19, flash 14, plume 3

Typical (median of non-neutral, count): gain 1.639 (499/501); core 0.8 (494/501); fadeIn 0.03 (465/501); fadeOut 0.03 (474/501); flicker 0.25 (35/501); twinkle 0.32 (474/501); spin 0.12 (468/501); soft 0.04 (500/501); nearFade 0.15 (501/501); pulse 0.06 (4/501)

Reviewed: 501/501

- `0x3200012E` (trail) — Lightning Bolt / Electric Discharge spark shedding (cyan; per-metre trail on the bolt and its Launch, also Galvanic Knight/Elemental Create/Destroy): 8-ray sparks shed every 7 cm, scattering 2-6 m/s and arcing down over 4 s; crackle 0.28 @16 Hz, glints 0.3, core 0.85 - one look for all four colour variants (consistency pass)
- `0x3200023D` (burst) — Melee hit sparks (SparkLow/Left/Right/Front/Back on armoured and construct targets), 10-spark tier: tiny 0.15->0.07 m white-violet spark stars spray ~1 m/s and drop under gravity in ~0.6 s; re-filed lightning->star (radial spark, not an arc); upgrade: hot core, brief glints, gentler crackle, natural white-violet (no extra saturation)
- `0x3200023E` (burst) — Melee hit sparks (SparkLow/Left/Right/Front/Back on armoured and construct targets), 15-spark tier: tiny 0.15->0.07 m white-violet spark stars spray ~1 m/s and drop under gravity in ~0.6 s; re-filed lightning->star (radial spark, not an arc); upgrade: hot core, brief glints, gentler crackle, natural white-violet (no extra saturation)
- `0x32000299` (fountain) — BreatheLightning spark spray (Grievver statue + lightning-breath creatures): tiny 5 cm yellow sparks sprayed out ~2 m/s from the mouth and falling hard over 0.5 s; strong 18 Hz crackle flicker, full core kept so the tiny sparks read
- `0x32000379` (implode) — ShieldUpGrey (Armor + Bludgeoning Protection buff; the sparkle part of the spinning grey shield column): grey 8-ray sparkles start ~1-2 m out and swing in through the target (implode) for 0.75 s over a 1.5 s cast; bright protective glints, core eased slightly
- `0x3200037B` (implode) — ShieldUpPurple (Lightning Protection buff; the sparkle part of the spinning purple shield column): purple 8-ray sparkles start ~1-2 m out and swing in through the target (implode) for 0.75 s over a 1.5 s cast; bright protective glints, core eased slightly
- `0x32000446` (swarm) — Radiant Blood / Eldrytch Web Crystal Array, Creeping Blight Banner, Obsidian Sentient Fragment ambient crystal aura (clockwise half, ~30 live): red cross-stars born tiny rise 0.5-0.75 m/s in a loose swirl and grow to 0.6 m as they fade over 1.5 s; persistent so gain/core lowered, slow 4 Hz glitter twinkle, softer where they cut the crystal mesh
- `0x32000447` (swarm) — Radiant Blood / Eldrytch Web Crystal Array, Creeping Blight Banner, Obsidian Sentient Fragment ambient crystal aura (counter-clockwise half, ~30 live): red cross-stars born tiny rise 0.5-0.75 m/s in a loose swirl and grow to 0.6 m as they fade over 1.5 s; persistent so gain/core lowered, slow 4 Hz glitter twinkle, softer where they cut the crystal mesh
